incompleteValue: ... (preview only; retain the result to inspect the complete value)
retainedValue: Complete retained source value: {count} characters. Inspect its reading to page the exact spelling.
resourceHelp: These operation limits are saved with this aggregation. Each source keeps its own declared limits; increasing an operation limit cannot enlarge a source declaration. Review the complete input spelling and exact output requirements before saving.
legacyPolicy: This retained recipe keeps its earlier resource rules. Explicitly upgrade it to use declared source and operation limits; the previous revision stays unchanged.
keyHelp: Numerical grouping treats equivalent spellings as one value. Exact source spelling keeps labels such as 10 and 010 separate. Every contributing source remains inspectable.
title: Grouped dataset title
help: Retain one row per group for reuse in calculations, figures and tables. Choose the grouping columns and the values to summarize. Group keys use exact stored spelling; for example, 1 and 1.0 remain separate. Missing, null and absent keys form separate groups. Output follows the first occurrence of each group.
name: Output column name
error: Stop if a reading is missing
rules: Excluded rows never contribute. Count counts present, non-excluded values. Other operations use exact fractions; an even-sized median is the mean of the two middle values. A group with no contributing values stays absent, except Count, which is zero. Original readings and their exclusions remain inspectable.
previewNote: First five groups, calculated from the complete retained input.
invalid: Choose 1 to 8 grouping columns and 1 to 32 aggregated values. Give each output a unique name. Use numerical input columns for operations other than Count.
provenance: These readings belong to the exact retained input revision. Inspect a reading to follow its own source evidence. Recalculation creates a new revision and keeps this result available.
quantileUpgradeHelp: Explicitly upgrade this recipe to add exact quantiles. Existing operations and the previous retained revision keep their meaning.
quantileVersion: This recipe supports exact quantiles with saved probability, method and resource limits.
quantileRules: Included readings are sorted by exact numerical value, ascending. Equal values keep their original source order. The position is (n - 1) × p, with exact linear interpolation between its bracketing values. Excluded rows are omitted; missing readings follow the selected rule.
busy: Aggregation operation in progress. Your entries are retained.
quantileEmpty: No included readings: the quantile is absent and has no bracketing readings.
requestTooLarge: This aggregation request is {bytes} UTF-8 bytes; the request limit is {maximum} bytes (2 MiB). Use fewer aggregated values or shorter scalar spellings, then retry. Your entries are retained.
pairedUpgradeHelp: Explicitly upgrade this retained recipe to add covariance and linear fit coefficients. Existing operations and the previous retained revision keep their meaning.
pairedVersion: This recipe supports covariance and linear fit coefficients from explicitly selected complete row pairs.
pairCoordinates: The input column is X. Select the paired column as Y. Both values come from the same retained row.
complete-rows-v1: Complete pairs from the same row
centered-pairs-v1: Covariance method: centered products of complete row pairs.
ordinary-least-squares-intercept-v1: Fit method: unweighted ordinary least squares with an intercept.
slope: Slope: change in Y per unit X
fitCoordinates: The fit uses the original declared X and Y coordinates. The intercept is the fitted Y coordinate at source X = 0.
pairRules: Excluded rows are omitted first. If either reading is missing, null or absent, the whole pair follows the selected missing-reading rule. Included counts complete pairs. Row order does not create a time alignment.
pairUnits: Both inputs need declared unit definitions, or both unit labels must be empty. Unit labels alone do not define compound units.
pairStatus-ready: The paired statistic is defined for these complete pairs.
pairStatus-no-pairs: No complete pairs remain; this result is absent.
pairStatus-insufficient-pairs: This statistic needs at least two complete pairs; this result is absent.
pairStatus-zero-x-spread: The complete pairs have no variation in X; the fit coefficient is absent.
pairPublicCovariance: Covariance of complete row pairs; centered products divided by {denominator} ({normalization})
pairPublic-slope: Unweighted ordinary least squares with intercept, using complete row pairs; slope is the change in Y per unit X
pairPublic-intercept: Unweighted ordinary least squares with intercept, using complete row pairs; intercept is Y at source X = 0
pearson-centered-pairs-v1: Pearson correlation from exact centered complete pairs
correlationRules: Each included row contributes one X and Y pair. Pearson correlation divides the centered cross-product sum by the square root of the two centered squared-spread sums. At least two complete pairs and nonzero spread in both coordinates are required.
correlationExactFirst: Exact rational results remain exact. When a square root requires approximation, retain the computed decimal using the saved working precision, rounding and library. Display digits affect presentation only.
correlationNoInference: This descriptive coefficient does not establish significance, causality, uncertainty or a confidence interval. Unavailable correlation is never replaced by zero.
correlationInvalidPolicy: Choose a valid saved engine 4 precision and rounding policy. Your correlation choices are retained.
correlationStatus-ready: Pearson correlation is defined for these complete pairs.
correlationStatus-no-pairs: No complete pairs remain; correlation is unavailable.
correlationStatus-insufficient-pairs: Fewer than two complete pairs remain; correlation is unavailable.
correlationStatus-zero-x-spread: The complete pairs have no variation in X; correlation is unavailable.
correlationStatus-zero-y-spread: The complete pairs have no variation in Y; correlation is unavailable.
correlationStatus-zero-both-spread: The complete pairs have no variation in either coordinate; correlation is unavailable.
correlationUpgradeHelp: Create a recipe revision with explicit Pearson correlation and its saved calculation policy. Existing covariance, fit and quantile metrics retain their methods.
correlationVersion: Pearson correlation uses complete row pairs and a saved exact-first calculation policy.
correlationPublicContext: Pearson correlation of complete row pairs; exact centered cross-products divided by the square root of both centered squared-spread sums
correlationApproximate: Approximate correlation under the saved calculation policy
correlationUnits: Declare both coordinate units, or leave both unit labels empty with no unit definitions. The declared dimensions may differ. Positive scales and absolute offsets cancel in centered correlation; the result is dimensionless.
correlationComputedDecimalHelp: This is the saved computational decimal before the chosen output encoding. Display digits do not shorten this retained value.
observation-variance-affine-v1: Affine fit with supplied observation variances
complete-triples-v1: Complete X, Y and variance triples from the same row
weightedUpgradeHelp: Explicitly upgrade this recipe to fit using supplied observation variances. Earlier retained revisions and existing unweighted fit methods keep their meaning.
weightedVersion: This recipe supports affine fits with explicit positive observation variances and a declared reference X coordinate.
chooseVarianceColumn: Choose the variance of Y column
weightedResult-slope: Slope: change in Y per unit X
weightedResult-intercept: Intercept: fitted Y at reference X
weightedResult-intercept-variance: Variance of fitted Y at reference X
weightedResult-coefficient-covariance: Covariance of slope and reference intercept
weightedResult-fitted-mean: Fitted mean Y at evaluation X
weightedResult-fitted-mean-variance: Variance of fitted mean Y at evaluation X
weightedCoordinateHelp: Reference X and evaluation X use the selected X column’s authored coordinate units and origin. The intercept is fitted Y at reference X.
weightedAssumptions: X is treated as fixed. Observation errors are independent, and supplied positive Y variances are treated as fixed. Each weight is the reciprocal of its supplied variance.
weightedNoInference: Weights are not inferred from residuals or rescaled by residual scatter. Fitted-mean variance excludes future-observation noise. No confidence interval or coverage claim is inferred.
weightedRules: Excluded rows are omitted first. If X, Y or its variance is missing, null or absent, the complete triple follows the selected missing-reading rule. Every included variance must be positive.
weightedUnits: Declare X and Y units and a difference unit for V with the dimensions of Y squared, or leave all three unit labels empty with no definitions. Unit labels alone do not define variances.
weightedInvalid: Choose X, Y, a variance column, a result and an exact reference X coordinate. Fitted-mean results also require an evaluation X coordinate. Your entries are retained.
weightedStatus-ready: The weighted affine fit is defined for these complete triples.
weightedStatus-no-pairs: No complete triples remain; this result is unavailable.
weightedStatus-insufficient-pairs: Fewer than two complete triples remain; this result is unavailable.
weightedStatus-zero-x-spread: The complete triples have no variation in X; this result is unavailable.
weightedPublicMethod: Affine fit with inverse supplied observation-variance weights
weightedPublicCoordinates: Parameter coordinates use the selected X column’s authored coordinate unit
